scope.impact_area: Admin paper request, retrieval, clarification, immutable output and revision journey
scope.discovery_scope: Current production renders, selected direction and retained references; read-only application inspection
scope.delivery: This independent critic record; no application edits

guidance.missing_legacy_paths: UI_AGENT_PROTOCOL.md and EXECUTION_ROUTING.md are referenced by local instructions but absent locally; current packaged Central release used.

independent_identity_check.method: Rehashed actual production build files, actual backend files selected by candidate algorithm, and fixture bytes; recomputed candidate independently. Rehashed every render.

status_reason: Independent visual pass only. Parent final checkpoint and final separate QA remain required for agent-reviewed. No owner acceptance.

critical_dimension_mapping.declared_conditions: Information hierarchy; natural-language request and durable paper object; current task before history.
critical_dimension_mapping.visible_reason: New paper presents one real free-text request. Register and record foreground the paper, exact action and separate completed outputs. The empty Mine state now explains creator scope and provides an appropriate direct action.

critical_dimension_mapping.declared_conditions: Exact clarification and primary answer visible on 390px without traversing history; clear return from notification.
critical_dimension_mapping.visible_reason: At 390px the complete marks-conflict question, answer field and Send reply fit before request/history; the same order holds at 320px. Notification selection closes Updates and reveals the destination title and active clarification. Blank-query Mine no longer instructs trying different search words.

critical_dimension_mapping.declared_conditions: Observed state or next scheduled opportunity, no fake completion time/progress; truthful loading, error and unsent state.
critical_dimension_mapping.visible_reason: Next opportunity includes date and IST, and explanatory copy distinguishes a start opportunity from completion. Waiting after an earlier opportunity is acknowledged. Loading, query failure, no results and failed submission have visibly different explanations. The failed-send capture retains the actual input. Legacy output explicitly says Version not recorded.

critical_dimension_mapping.declared_conditions: Global historical retrieval, distinguishing identity, full dates, bounded continuation and history context.
critical_dimension_mapping.visible_reason: Two identical long academic titles retain distinct shortened IDs and full 2024/2022 dates, with Copy ID in detail. Continue search shows 59 loaded records and the exhausted result shows all 65. History shows 150 activity/100 request context, then 161/161 and beginning reached, including the 2011 original at desktop. Whole-word and eight-word limitations remain explicit.

critical_dimension_mapping.declared_conditions: Completed version remains available with active revision; separate paper/key; immutable selected output identity carried to print.
critical_dimension_mapping.visible_reason: The science record simultaneously shows Version 1 ready and Request 2 queued, with separate links and an active revision section. Paper/key viewer and actual PDF page rasters show the same saved paper ID visual-v1-geography-v1 and recorded Version 1, with clearly separate student and teacher content. Fixture inspection links that immutable saved row to the originating geography record and request revision 1. Saved paper ID is honestly the artifact identity, not mislabeled as the conversation identity.

critical_dimension_mapping.declared_conditions: 320/390px reachability, readable controls and typography, no horizontal dependency, useful action hierarchy.
critical_dimension_mapping.visible_reason: All four register views and Bank tools remain visible. Text and long titles wrap within one column; reply and output controls remain legible at 320px. Narrow notification return exposes the current object. Desktop rows translate into stacked records rather than compressed columns.

critical_dimension_mapping.declared_conditions: Compact density, readable typography, coherent composition and visual continuity with selected C.
critical_dimension_mapping.visible_reason: The saved viewer now uses the same green controls, quiet paper background, typography and reduced navigation as the record journey. The redundant Saved paper hero and blue tab layer are removed. Document-level headings and identity remain distinct from the workspace controls. Amber clarification, green saved output and restrained failure treatment carry actual meaning.

visible_improvements_from_round4: Saved paper/key and print now expose the stable saved artifact ID and actual recorded version; unknown legacy metadata is explicit.
Saved viewer green shell and restrained hierarchy now connect to the accepted register direction.
Selecting an update dismisses the popover and exposes the destination paper and current task on desktop, 390px and 320px.
Empty Created by me with a blank query now explains the true scope and offers Show papers from all admins.
Actual production bundle evidence and two exported PDF page rasters replace prior development-only and print-media-only uncertainty for these fixtures.

generic_risk_assessments.decision: Semantic panels for clarification, completed output and active revision
generic_risk_assessments.reason: They separate different objects and actions; the older version does not masquerade as the active request.

generic_risk_assessments.decision: Additional saved-viewer heading and colored tab layer
generic_risk_assessments.reason: Current shell removes the extra hero and aligns the controls with the green workspace. Repeated document title inside the immutable printable page is purposeful, not another competing app hero.

generic_risk_assessments.decision: Textual loading, error and empty panels
generic_risk_assessments.reason: Simple status content matches an operational register. Copy now distinguishes blank creator scope, a searched no-match result, loading and failed access.

reference_comparisons.matched_mechanism: Actionable update list separate from underlying durable record
reference_comparisons.visible_gap: Linear's rows offer denser secondary context. Current Updates uses simple title/event/time rows, sufficient for the demonstrated two events; selection now reveals the current record.
reference_comparisons.disposition: Retain concise update treatment; no requirement to imitate palette or notification lifecycle.

reference_comparisons.matched_mechanism: Stable record identity attached to conversation and current state
reference_comparisons.visible_gap: Intercom keeps properties and conversation simultaneously visible. This paper flow intentionally puts the current task first and discloses prior activity; both identity and action remain clear.
reference_comparisons.disposition: Retain task-first record composition and corrected notification return.

reference_comparisons.matched_mechanism: Prominent persistent retrieval controls and explicit scope
reference_comparisons.visible_gap: Drive exposes richer visible facets. This implementation offers supported word search, status and creator scope with continuation/end context; it is less expressive but truthful.
reference_comparisons.disposition: Retain supported retrieval controls. Do not fabricate academic/date facets merely to imitate reference.

strongest_reference_gap: The current retrieval controls are less expressive than Drive's visible facets, and the existing app chrome makes the phone register less compact than the selected concept. Neither hides the immediate task or the supported scope; this limits the score rather than requiring unsupported controls.
highest_priority_correction: No further blocking visual correction identified. Preserve the reviewed output identity and notification/empty-state repairs; finish independent QA and parent judgment on this exact candidate before an agent-reviewed claim.

type.reason: Academic titles lead, operational text stays legible and the clarification question has clear emphasis.

color.reason: Green viewer controls now match the register; status tints are restrained and paired with text.

spacing.reason: Rows and stacked records are readable, with sufficient separation for current actions; existing chrome causes some extra height but no task obstruction.

composition.reason: Current task/output precedes request and history; active revision remains visibly separate from saved output.

navigation.reason: Visible status views, Bank tools, paper return and notification dismissal preserve context.

imagery.reason: No decorative imagery is needed; saved document surface is the relevant visual object. These fixtures contain text only.

motion.reason: Static captures cannot establish motion or measured perception.

baseline_provenance.inspection_timing: Personally viewed after independent direction selection and before baseline hash recording at 06:03:40Z.
baseline_provenance.exception: User-directed clean-slate exploration deliberately excluded the rejected baseline from the original designer and blind selector. They were not supplied parent design ideas. This is a reset of an existing surface, not a genuinely new surface.
baseline_provenance.no_retroactive_claim: This later inspection does not imply the original designer, blind selector or any previous critic saw these baseline files.
baseline_provenance.visible_comparison: Rejected baseline foregrounds recent chats and a conversation composer, with repeated surrounding navigation. Current candidate foregrounds a searchable stable register and a task-first record. Current icon glyphs also render normally.

coverage_note: Personally viewed all 71 current browser captures and both actual PDF page rasters in the round-5 manifest. Also viewed both production auth-error capture files; they have identical bytes and constitute one visual error-state appearance reached by two QA scenarios, not two distinct visual designs. History/long-result captures show bounded visible portions rather than every loaded record.
unobserved_or_limited: No true globally empty admin-wide register capture; current first-use case is an empty creator-filtered account.
No motion or measured 100ms/1s/5s attention/comprehension study.
Print evidence covers the simple one-page text fixtures only; it does not establish complex math, image or multipage pagination quality.
Critic inspected static auth-error outcomes but did not execute timing races, keyboard navigation, screen-reader checks or backend authorization tests; those belong to separate QA.
Not a live deployment or production-data verification; renders use the actual local production bundle with emulator fixture data.
qa_note: Separate QA reported production smoke 9/9 at 1280/390/320, production auth 2/2 and dev auth 4/4, but its remaining regression gate/final verdict was pending when this visual record was written. QA results did not raise visual scores.
first_glance_note: Eye path and rapid comprehension are design hypotheses, not measured participant outcomes.
